title: Soveraeign Witness Pack (PROPOSED)
description: What a witness pass is handed instead of a prose brief: the prior receipt over the same subject, the exact digest delta since that receipt, the commits the builder landed in between, the custody exit the subject serves, and a RecordProjection over the subject at the current head. A pass re-derives the claims that cite a moved address and carries the rest from the prior receipt as input findings. The pack is derived from the record and the tree; it asserts nothing about the subject, grants nothing, and is rebuilt rather than kept.

subject.description: The witness subject, as the record under witness/<subject>.md names it.

subject_roots.description: Repository directories the prior receipt's subject addresses fall under. History is read for these and nothing else.

serves_exit.description: The live custody whose member the subject is, or null when no custody claims it. A pass over a subject that serves no exit is still a pass; it is not phase work.

builder_commits.description: Commits between the prior receipt's revision and the head that touch a subject root. Their messages are the builder's claims, which the pass checks and never adopts.

record_projection.description: A RecordProjection conforming to record-projection.schema.json over the subject addresses at the head. Validated against that contract separately; this schema only requires its identity fields.

prior.description: The receipt this pass carries forward. Verdict and standing are what that receipt said; the pass re-reads them as claims.

delta.description: Exactly what moved under the subject since the prior receipt. Recomputed from bytes, never read from a field that states its own freshness.

added_source.description: The command that produced `added`, or UNAVAILABLE with the reason, so a reader knows whether an empty list means nothing was added or nothing could be read.
